_info: First 12 motion entries of every recorded step of rotary_raw.json as [report as 64-byte hex, how many identical reports in a row]. Motion = a nonzero byte among bytes 1-44 (report 0x05) or 1-48 (report 0x06); bytes 45-46 of report 0x05 hold a constant value in the trackball recordings. The expected direction of each step is written by hand in tests/test_rotary_replay.py.
